## Intended function

Six quad amplifiers: two stages per input plus three ADC buffers and reference buffer

## Recorded findings

Quad RRIO amplifier on +3V3A. Supply range 1.8-5.5 V. 10 MHz is a nominal device property, not system bandwidth.

The exact D package uses no shutdown pin. Catalog descriptions of an enable/shutdown feature apply to other variants.
